Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks for signing up and requesting a demo — I’m Rishi on the Redwood team, I handle inbound demo intake. Before we lock a 30-min slot I had a few quick fit questions so we can tailor the session and make sure the right folks join. If you prefer to skip these and see a general overview, say so and I’ll book straight away.

Quick questions (2–3 short answers is perfect):
- Primary use case you want to evaluate? (e.g., retrieval-augmented search for docs, summarization, classification, embeddings for semantic search)
- Expected volume: requests/month or tokens/month (ballpark is fine)
- Timeline: POC/PO? When would you like to be in production?
- Any must-have security/compliance constraints (SSO, VPC, data residency, SOC2 evidence)?
- Tech stack note: where would inference sit (cloud provider / on-prem / hybrid)?

Proposed demo slots (all 30 min):
- Thu Aug 13 — 12:00 PM ET
- Thu Aug 13 — 3:30 PM ET
- Fri Aug 14 — 9:00 AM ET

I’ve attached a short solution brief and a one-pager template you can use to share sample signal ahead of the call.

If any of the slots above work, reply with the preferred time and we’ll send the invite.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Rishi — thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below:

- Primary use case: We want to build an embeddings-backed semantic search over 5+ years of customer invoices and ticket notes, plus a small summarization layer for finance ops. The team is also evaluating extractive fields to populate a downstream system.
- Volume: Estimate ~8–12M tokens/month initially (spike to ~20M with seasonal volume).
- Timeline: POC in September, production target Q4 (Nov).
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, data cannot leave the US region for now. SSO (Okta) is mandatory for demo access.
- Stack: AWS-hosted services, would prefer a VPC option if available.

Of the proposed times, Thu Aug 13 at 12:00 PM ET works best for our team. Elena (cc’d) is the engineering lead and will also attend.

Two quick questions for your side before we meet:
1) Do you support Okta SSO for console/access?
2) Can you run inference in a US-only region / private VPC?

Thanks — look forward to the session.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Blue Ridge Finance
samir.patel@blueridgefinance.com

Hi Samir — Marissa on the solutions team, looping in to run the demo and cover architecture.

Thanks for the details — that helps a lot. Confirming Thu Aug 13 at 12:00 PM ET for a 30-minute call. Agenda I propose:
- 5 min intros + goals
- 10 min demo focused on embeddings & search pipelines
- 10 min architecture and deployment options (VPC / private control plane)
- 5 min next steps / POC definition

About your questions: quick answers for the call —
- Okta SSO: yes, we support SAML/Okta for console and API access in our Private/Dedicated offerings; we’ll show the flow.
- US-only/VPC: yes, we offer Private deployments with US-only residency and VPC options. We’ll sketch the trade-offs (hosted vs private) on the call.

Could you share a small sample of the data (anonymized invoice text) or a sample query you’d like the search to solve? If you prefer not to share data, a short list of representative queries will work.

I’ll own the architecture portion and run through recommended batch sizes and quantization profiles for cost/latency trade-offs so you have an idea for POC sizing.

Thanks — calendar invite forthcoming from Rishi.

—
